complaint.subject: Formal Complaint: Uncredited Transfer of NGN 85,000.00 - Ref 000013261108141205184426937051
complaint.content:
10 November 2026

To Customer Complaints / Customer Care Unit
Northbridge Bank

Dear Sir/Madam,

RE: FORMAL COMPLAINT REGARDING UNCREDITED TRANSFER OF NGN 85,000.00

I am writing to formally lodge a complaint regarding a failed funds transfer from my account with Northbridge Bank. My details are as follows:
- Customer Name: Amara Okeke
- Account Number: [ADD: account number]
- Email: amara.demo.1794340743315@example.com
- Phone Number: [ADD: phone number]
- Preferred Contact Method: Email

On 8 November 2026 at 14:12, I performed a transfer of NGN 85,000.00 via the Northbridge Bank mobile banking app to Example Recipient at Example Microfinance Bank (account ending 4417). The transaction reference for this payment is 000013261108141205184426937051.

My account was debited immediately and the mobile app indicated that the transfer was successful. However, the recipient has confirmed that the money has not been credited to their account. Please note that a transfer receipt or a "Successful" status on the app is not proof that the money reached the recipient or that the transaction settled.

I previously contacted customer care on 9 November 2026 to report this issue and was advised to wait 24 hours. That time has elapsed and the issue remains unresolved. I was not provided with an official complaint reference number during that call.

In support of this complaint, I have enclosed the following evidence:
- Transfer receipt from my banking app (evidence-transfer-receipt.png)

I request that you kindly resolve this issue by taking one of the following actions:
1. Reverse the debit of NGN 85,000.00 to my account, or
2. Confirm that the transaction has successfully settled and the funds have been credited to the recipient.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and provide me with an official complaint reference number for tracking.

Thank you for your assistance.

Yours faithfully,

Amara Okeke
